notes.title: Update Patch: v1.0.1
notes.content: Bugfix: When using a controller and aligning the cursor to a target, the cursor position is blown off.

notes.title: August 2: New Game Launch Announcement
notes.content:
Released on Friday, August 2!
The first installment of a new training x rhythm game.

Early Access price + launch discount makes it very affordable.
This title will be released simultaneously in both [SteamVR version] and [regular version].
